name: Kollam
tagline: The old port of Quilon and the cashew coast
summary: Kollam: an ancient trading port on Ashtamudi Lake, with backwaters, cashew and coir industries, Munroe Island, Thenmala and nearby Amritapuri.

history.overview: Kollam was a prominent port, visited by merchants from Arabia and China; the Malayalam calendar (Kollavarsham) is traditionally dated from 825 CE. Portuguese, Dutch and British traders followed, leaving Thangassery's fort and lighthouse.

timeline.event: Kollavarsham calendar era begins, traditionally linked to Kollam.
Described as a bustling port by Marco Polo and Ibn Battuta.
Portuguese establish a trading post; Dutch and British follow.

unique: Thenmala, one of India's first planned eco-tourism destinations
Close to Amritapuri, Oachira and Veda Heritage

bestTime.why: Pleasant weather for boating, beaches and eco-tourism.
